text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen about 7% from Period 3 to Period 10, a reminder that staying invested does not prevent losses; I should make sure the portfolio's risk suits my needs.","Not trading has avoided impulsive decisions, but repeated inaction is not a substitute for checking whether my holdings remain diversified and appropriately sized.","Before changing positions, I should use a clear plan—such as target allocations and review rules—instead of reacting to recent price moves."]}
